channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Guild Wars® Bonus Mission Pack
item.description: Step into Tyriaʼs past as its greatest heroes, experience their defining moments, and claim exclusive rewards in the Bonus Mission Pack.

item.title: State of Decay: YOSE
item.description: Make your stand against the collapse of society in the ultimate zombie survival-fantasy game. Explore an open world full of dangers and opportunities that respond to your every decision. Recruit a community of playable survivors, each with their own unique skills and talents.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE - Chronicles: Alexander the Great
item.description: Embark on Alexander the Great’s epic journey in this narrative-driven campaign featuring three new civilizations, customizable armies, and fresh storytelling.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE - The Three Kingdoms
item.description: Journey across a thousand years of Chinese history and dive into the epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms with the latest expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - where history and legend collide in a battle for supremacy.

item.title: Age of Empires II: DE – The Last Chieftains
item.description: Venture into medieval South America to command the Mapuche, Muisca, and Tupi through dense jungles and vivid landscapes in three epic campaigns where folklore, warfare, and endless intrigue collide.

item.title: Age of Empires IV: The Sultans Ascend
item.description: Lead powerful forces in defense of your homeland in The Sultans Ascend – the exciting new expansion to Age of Empires IV. Experience a brand-new campaign set in the Middle East, or command new armies with the Japanese and Byzantines.

item.title: Age of Empires IV: Dynasties of the East
item.description: Expand your legacy in Dynasties of the East—featuring 4 new variant civilizations, 8 maps, 6 biomes, and a new roguelite RTS experience with dynamic challenges and unpredictable wave-based attacks

item.title: Age of Empires IV: Knights of Cross and Rose
item.description: Command two well-known armies inspired by history in this epic return to Age of Empires IV!

item.title: Ark Nova
item.description: Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.

item.title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land
item.description: "Atelier Yumia" is a story about “memory”. Explore the field to gather materials and synthesis items. The items you create can be key to advancing the story and can also be used in battles and exploration. Additionally, you can create your own base with “Building" in the field.

item.title: Chocolate Factory Simulator
item.description: Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of your automaton assistant Nougat.

item.title: Cuphead - The Delicious Last Course
item.description: Cuphead and Mugman are joined by Ms. Chalice for a DLC add-on adventure on a brand new island! With new weapons, new charms, and Ms. Chalice's brand new abilities, take on a new cast of multi-faceted, screen-filling bosses to assist Chef Saltbaker in Cuphead's final challenging quest.

item.title: Football, Tactics & Glory
item.description: XCOM meets Football Manager. Develop your club, earn experience in turn-based matches, learn new skills, achieve new classes, upgrade your facilities, buy and sell footballers, grow your youth academy, make difficult choices. It's a deep strategy game that respects your time.

item.title: Guild Wars® Eye of the North™
item.description: Journey to the Far Shiverpeaks and beyond, where new allies and ancient foes are stirring beneath Tyria. Forge alliances, conquer perilous dungeons, and secure a legacy in the Hall of Monuments

item.title: Lords of the Fallen
item.description: A vast world awaits in the medieval, dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. As a fabled Dark Crusader, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God. The final major update Version 2.5 is out now: features deadlier boss battles and all-new Veteran Mode.

item.title: PICO PARK 2
item.description: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

item.title: Pillars of Eternity
item.description: Prepare to be enchanted by a world where the choices you make and the paths you choose shape your destiny. Obsidian Entertainment, the developer of Fallout: New Vegas™ and South Park: The Stick of Truth™, together with Paradox Interactive is proud to present Pillars of Eternity.

item.title: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire
item.description: Patch 5.0 - Turn-based mode and The Ultimate challenge out now! Pursue a rogue god over land and sea in the sequel to the multi-award-winning RPG Pillars of Eternity. Captain your ship on a dangerous voyage of discovery across the vast unexplored archipelago region of the Deadfire.

item.title: Quantum Break
item.description: From Remedy Entertainment, the masters of cinematic action games, comes Quantum Break, a time-amplified suspenseful blockbuster. The Quantum Break experience is part game, part live action show—where decisions in one dramatically affect the other.

item.title: Street Fighter™ 6 - Year 2 Ultimate Pass
item.description: Year 2 Ultimate Pass - 4 additional characters - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 2 (including colors 1-10) - 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 3 (including colors 1-10) - 2 additional stages - Bonus: 7,700 Drive Tickets

item.title: Sunset Overdrive
item.description: Sunset Overdrive transforms an open-world apocalypse into your tactical playground. Zip, grind and wall-run across Sunset City with an unconventional arsenal. Hyper-agility, unique weapons, and customizable abilities deliver an explosive and irreverent adventure in the end times.

item.title: The Doors of Trithius
item.description: The Doors of Trithius is an open-world RPG roguelike. Engage in tactical turn-based combat in a living world of warring factions, wandering behemoths, and ancient magic. Level your skills, cook, craft, and explore dungeons. Will you follow the story, or let adventure be your guide?

item.title: The Outer Worlds 2
item.description: The Outer Worlds 2 is the sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.

item.title: Until Then
item.description: A fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

item.title: We Happy Few
item.description: From the independent studio that brought you Contrast, We Happy Few is an action/adventure game set in a drug-fuelled, retrofuturistic city in an alternative 1960s England. Hide, fight and conform your way out of this delusional, Joy-obsessed world.

item.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
item.description: 42 Civilizations, 229 Campaign Missions, Singleplayer, Co-Op, Multiplayer, In-Game Editor, Mods, Cross-play...It is good to be the king.

item.title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
item.description: Celebrating its first year of delighting millions of global players, the award-winning and best-selling strategy franchise continues with Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition, putting you at the center of even more epic historical battles that shaped the world.

item.title: Age of Mythology: Retold
item.description: Play as mythological Gods and smite your enemies in this award-winning, mythological Real-Time Strategy classic given new life. Wage war across timeless campaigns, fierce skirmishes, and god-powered multiplayer modes.

item.title: Airport Security Sucks!
item.description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

item.title: Ara History Untold: Anniversary Edition
item.description: Build a nation starting at any point in human history and compete for supremacy in this epic turn-based strategy game. Engage in diplomacy, fight wars, and go head-to-head with other leaders from history.

item.title: Avowed
item.description: Avowed is a first-person fantasy RPG set in the world of Eora, where your choices carve a path through war, intrigue, and ancient mysteries. Navigate a land in turmoil, forge powerful alliances or deadly rivalries, and wield magic and steel to shape the fate of the Living Lands—and your own destiny.

item.title: Cooking Simulator
item.description: A realistic cooking sim where every ingredient reacts with real physics. Master 80+ dishes in Career mode or go wild in Sandbox as you cook, experiment, or cause total kitchen chaos in a fully interactive chef’s playground.

item.title: Cuphead
item.description: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

item.title: Drova - Forsaken Kin
item.description: Drova is an Action-RPG that marries the dark grim tones of its genre with the mysticism of Celtic mythology. Encounter a society where ancient restless spirits and divided factions battle for dominance. Uncover forgotten abilities and unravel the secrets of a past shrouded in mystery.

item.title: Endling - Extinction is Forever
item.description: As the last mother fox on Earth, your cubs need all your care to survive in a merciless world that slowly destroys itself. You have to help them, teach them and save them. And you should never forget that extinction is forever – in the real world and in this 2023 BAFTA award winning experience.

item.title: Fable Anniversary
item.description: FOR EVERY CHOICE, A CONSEQUENCE.Fully re-mastered with HD visuals and audio, Fable Anniversary is a stunning rendition of the original game that will delight faithful fans and new players alike! The all new Heroic difficulty setting will test the mettle of even the most hardcore Fable fan.

item.title: Forza Horizon 5
item.description: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

item.title: Forza Motorsport
item.description: Compete in over 500 cars on 30 world-famous tracks – now featuring the legendary Fujimi Kaido! Play the new 20th Anniversary Tour and obtain special rewards.

item.title: Grounded
item.description: The world is a vast, beautiful and dangerous place – especially when you have been shrunk to the size of an ant. Can you thrive alongside the hordes of giant insects, fighting to survive the perils of the backyard?

item.title: Guild Wars® Reforged
item.description: Step into Guild Wars Reforged, the award-winning online roleplaying game enjoyed by millions, now re-energized with system enhancements and Steam Deck verified. Experience the complete saga— from the fall of Ascalon to the desperate stand against Nightfall. Your adventure is just getting started!

item.title: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition
item.description: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition is an enhanced version of the real-time strategy classic, Halo Wars, updated to run natively on PC. Halo Wars: Definitive Edition includes improved graphics, new achievements and all of the DLC created for the landmark real-time strategy game.

item.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
item.description: Explore the world with our largest fleet of aircraft and take simulation to new heights while pursuing your aviation career within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

item.title: Minecraft Dungeons
item.description: Fight your way through an exciting action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

item.title: My Time at Sandrock
item.description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

item.title: NINJA GAIDEN 4
item.description: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with NINJA GAIDEN 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

item.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
item.description: Play the critically acclaimed masterpiece. Embark on a new journey in a vast, exotic world where you’ll encounter towering enemies and challenging puzzles on your quest to unravel Ori’s destiny.

item.title: RACCOIN: Coin Pusher Roguelike
item.description: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

item.title: Scritchy Scratchy
item.description: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

item.title: Sea of Thieves: 2026 Edition
item.description: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.

item.title: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II
item.description: The sequel to the award winning Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, Senua returns in a brutal journey of survival through the myth and torment of Viking Iceland. Intent on saving those who have fallen victim to the horrors of tyranny, Senua faces a battle of overcoming the darkness within and without.

item.title: South of Midnight
item.description: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Explore the mythos and confront mysterious creatures of the Deep South in this modern folktale while learning to weave an ancient power to surmount obstacles and unravel your family’s hidden past.

item.title: State of Decay 2: Juggernaut Edition
item.description: The dead have risen and civilization has fallen. Now it's up to you to gather survivors, scavenge for resources and build a community in a post-apocalyptic world – a world where you define what it means to survive in this ultimate zombie survival simulation.

item.title: Tell Me Why: Chapter 2
item.description: The Ronan twins continue to uncover Mary-Ann's secrets, but find that some people who knew her want the truth to stay buried. Michael helps Tyler adapt to life in Delos Crossing, while Alyson struggles with the tension between her brother and Uncle Eddy.

item.title: Tell Me Why: Chapter 3
item.description: The search for their father's identity has thrown the twins' lives into turmoil. Fearing he's lost his sister, Tyler continues the pursuit alone. Meanwhile, Alyson's guilt brings her into conflict with the people she loves most, as the heart-rending Tell Me Why trilogy concludes!

item.title: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time
item.description: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a sandboxy physics game for 1-8 players, with everything from sneaky heists to hilarous stupidity to baking pizzas. With continuous updates, plenty of maps, and hundreds of items, clothes and quests, it has something for everyone.

item.title: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
item.description: Equipped with cutting-edge salvaging tech, carve & slice spaceships to recover valuable materials. Upgrade your gear to take on more lucrative contracts and pay your billion credits debt to LYNX Corp!

item.title: Ice Cream Simulator
item.description: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

item.title: Street Fighter™ 6 - Year 2 Character Pass
item.description: Year 2 Character Pass - 4 additional characters (M. Bison, Terry, Mai, Elena) - 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10 - Bonus: 4,200 Drive Tickets

item.title: Gravity Circuit
item.description: Gravity Circuit is a flashy action packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Follow Kai, a lone operative war hero who harnesses the mysterious powers of the Gravity Circuit, on an adventure in a futuristic world inhabited by sentient robots.
